모델: Omni 1.2 Flash와 Veo 3.1 - Quality를 같은 지시문 · 같은 GPT 시작 그림으로 견주는 LAB 영상 시험(11-25 유호님 「응, 시험해」)
공통: One continuous shot, no cuts. The camera is locked off exactly as in the start frame: no zoom, no pan, no tilt, no shake. Keep the exact handmade needle-felt miniature look of the start frame in every frame: fine wool felt fibres, visible stitches, matte felt and wool; every object keeps its shape, size and colour and never turns into a realistic thing. MONGLE is the coral-pink felt blob with the cream sheep-head towel. Mongle has NO mouth, NO arms, NO legs, NO hands and NO neck, ever: no mouth ever opens or appears on it, no limbs ever grow. It moves only by tilting, squashing, stretching and bouncing its whole soft dome body, and shows feeling only with its two glossy black bead eyes (they can grow bigger and rounder, or squeeze shut into two short dark stitched lines) and by its coral wool flushing red. LOOK: the same warm golden-amber light and soft orange glow as the start frame, unchanged to the last frame. Nothing new appears that is not in the start frame. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos. No sound.

클립.prompt: The felt jjimjilbang rest hall from the start frame: Mongle on the warm amber mat in the foreground, the felt bowl of roasted felt eggs beside it, the two felt friends with sheep-head towels sitting in the back. ACTION: From 0 to 1.2 s Mongle leans its whole body a little further toward the egg bowl, curious, its bead eyes on the nearest egg. At about 1.3 s its scalloped hem touches the nearest egg and a small sharp puff of white steam pops out. From 1.4 to 1.8 s Mongle freezes, both bead eyes pop bigger and rounder, and its wool flushes bright red from the hem upward. At about 1.9 s it jumps straight up off the mat in shock, stretching a little taller, its eyes squeezed shut into two short stitched lines; a soft round shadow stays on the mat below it. From 3.0 to 3.6 s it drops and lands a little to the left of where it sat, squashing wide and low, then wobbles back into its round dome shape, still flushed red, a thin wisp of steam rising from its hem. When it jumps, the two friends in the back flinch in surprise and the girl's paper fan stops mid-air; from 4 s to the end both friends laugh, the boy covering his mouth with his hand, while Mongle sits still and trembles slightly. The bowl and every egg never move.
